purpose: Task lifecycle MCP surface for claiming, executing, evidencing, reviewing, blocking, and truthfully finishing task work.
first_use: Call task_lifecycle_guidance when you first see a lifecycle task, when a refusal is unclear, or before recovering from incomplete task evidence.

Turn-boundary protocol: the canonical opening and closing inbox checks belong to the admitted carrier mailbox or epistemic inbox surface. Perform two distinct inbox reads: one before substantive work and one after work before the final response.
task_lifecycle_bridge_poll is not a turn-boundary inbox check. It is an inbox-to-task materialization pass and may mutate lifecycle state unless dry_run=true.
Inspect the task before mutation; claim only when authorized; submit execution notes, verification, changed-file evidence, and closeout through lifecycle tools.
Use payload_ref for long companion fields and preserve structuredContent as authoritative lifecycle evidence.
Use task_lifecycle_tags_update for audited site-local labels; tags are descriptive and never replace routing, authorization, priority, dependency, review, or closure state.

The carrier-facing runtime never prepares SQLite: run task-lifecycle-mcp --prepare --site-root <site-root> once before stateful calls. If a stateful call returns task_lifecycle_store_not_prepared, inspect task_lifecycle_doctor.preparation and perform explicit preparation instead of retrying.
Call mcp_runtime_proxy_status when this carrier-bound surface may be running an old build; inspect runtime_freshness.status and execute only the machine-readable carrier/supervisor reload_action.

ordinary_task.intent: Do task work through explicit lifecycle records instead of conversational claims.
canonical_sequence: do the implementation or investigation work
read the returned lifecycle status before reporting done

state_semantics.in_review: Work is submitted but closure is gated by review or dependency policy.

blocked_task.intent: Record exact blockers without pretending the task is complete.
canonical_sequence: do not use finish for unresolved blockers
required_evidence: next_action when an external action is required

payloads.intent: Use immutable payload refs for long companion fields while keeping task_number and agent_id top-level.
canonical_sequence: call lifecycle tool with payload_ref plus required top-level identity/routing fields
payloads.inline_limit_guidance: Inline companion strings over 20000 characters should move to payload_ref when the target tool supports it.

examples.purpose: Submit ordinary work with long notes.
Finish an outcome-contract task with structured findings.
Report a blocked task with detailed blocker evidence.

payload.next_action: <long exact action needed to unblock continuation>

review_and_dependencies.intent: Review is dependency/outcome work, not a magic final state.
canonical_sequence: submit_work with reviewer when ordinary work needs review

state_semantics.completed_outcome: An outcome was admitted for the task.
state_semantics.dependency_satisfied: Parent gating dependency has an admitted satisfying outcome.
state_semantics.rejected_outcome: Blocks parent closure until disposition is recorded.

closeout_truthfulness.intent: Report the strongest true lifecycle state, not the desired state.
common_mistakes: Using finish when blocked facts remain unresolved.
Treating generated reports as self-authorizing closure.

first_use_decision_tree.condition: You do not have a task number.
sequence: claim the recommended task when appropriate

first_use_decision_tree.condition: You are blocked by missing input, authority, credentials, failing infrastructure, or unclear external state.
sequence: task_lifecycle_report_blocked with exact blocker facts and next_action
task_lifecycle_show to read outcome contract and terminal state

first_use_decision_tree.condition: The carrier-bound server is stale or wedged.
sequence: task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool with an admitted server_path for one-shot recovery evidence
route runtime_freshness.reload_action to the carrier/runtime supervisor

first_use_decision_tree.condition: Your summary, verification, findings, or blocker details are too long for inline fields.
sequence: mcp_payload_create with companion fields under payload
retry lifecycle tool with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id

state_truth_table.opened: Task exists and is available or waiting; no current agent responsibility is implied.
state_truth_table.claimed: An agent has accepted responsibility; no completion is implied. A closed or confirmed task must not enter this state without an explicit reopen/continue trace.
state_truth_table.submitted: A report or evidence packet was recorded by a tool call; closure is not implied.
state_truth_table.completed_outcome: A task_outcome was admitted as completed; closure may still be gated by review or dependencies.
state_truth_table.in_review: Submitted work awaits review or dependency satisfaction; do not report this as closed.
state_truth_table.awaiting_dependencies: Parent work is not closed because one or more dependencies must satisfy outcomes first.
state_truth_table.closed: Closure authority has been recorded; this is the normal terminal claim for task completion. Claiming or submitting a new outcome requires task_lifecycle_reopen or task_lifecycle_continue first.
state_truth_table.confirmed: A stronger finalization state when supported by local policy; treat as at least closed and require an explicit reopen/continue trace before new work or outcomes.
state_truth_table.deferred: Work is intentionally paused; do not treat as completed.
state_truth_table.blocked: Known blocker prevents truthful completion until resolved or explicitly dispositioned.

tags.intent: Maintain small, site-local descriptive labels for discovery and related-task suggestions.
canonical_sequence: task_lifecycle_tags_update with the complete desired tag set and a reason
re-read task_lifecycle_show to inspect the audited update

semantics.normalization: Tags are trimmed, lowercased, converted to kebab-case, deduplicated, and bounded to 20 tags of at most 64 characters each.
semantics.scope: Tags belong to this Site only.
semantics.authority: The active task owner or an architect/operator may update them.
semantics.boundaries: Tags never affect authorization, routing, priority, dependencies, review, or closure.
semantics.relatedness: Explicit overlap is preferred; derived title/goal/context terms are only a fallback for untagged or legacy tasks.

anti_patterns.mistake: Saying a task is closed when the lifecycle status is submitted, in_review, awaiting_dependencies, blocked, or deferred.
anti_patterns.correction: Report the exact lifecycle status and whether closure authority exists.

anti_patterns.mistake: Putting task_number or agent_id only inside a payload.
anti_patterns.correction: Keep authority/routing fields top-level; payload carries companion fields.

anti_patterns.mistake: Calling finish or submit_work when blocker facts remain unresolved.
anti_patterns.correction: Use task_lifecycle_report_blocked with blockers and next_action.
Provide changed-file evidence or explicitly declare no_files_changed.

anti_patterns.mistake: Treating generated reports, review artifacts, or model narration as self-authorizing closure.
anti_patterns.correction: Use lifecycle readback: outcome, evidence verdict, dependencies, and closure status.

anti_patterns.mistake: Forcing authority_basis to bypass routing without real operator/task-owner authority.
anti_patterns.correction: Only use authority_basis when the authority exists and can be summarized truthfully.

anti_patterns.mistake: Using tags to imply ownership, urgency, dependency, review, or closure.
anti_patterns.correction: Treat tags as descriptive site-local labels and use the authoritative lifecycle/routing fields for state and authority.

recovery_guidance.failure: Inline field too long or structurally awkward.
recovery_guidance.action: Call task_lifecycle_payload_schema for the target tool, create mcp_payload_create with companion fields under payload, then retry with payload_ref.
Read task_lifecycle_show and roster/routing state; claim only if eligible or provide a truthful authority_basis when explicitly authorized.

recovery_guidance.failure: Evidence rejected or acceptance criteria unchecked.
recovery_guidance.action: Fix task notes, verification, changed-file/no-files evidence, and criteria proof before retrying finish.

recovery_guidance.failure: Review or dependency is blocking closure.
recovery_guidance.action: Find the dependency task or review obligation, finish it with the required outcome, then re-check parent dependency satisfaction.

recovery_guidance.failure: Tool result is ambiguous or live MCP seems stale after source edits.
recovery_guidance.action: Record the observed result exactly, verify source with focused tests, and request/rely on carrier restart before claiming live behavior changed.
Re-read the task, use the active task owner or an architect/operator identity, pass the complete normalized tag set, and include a concise reason.
